forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended; checkpoints/findings are never global completion; maintain nonempty frontier and exact next action until hard runtime/tool termination
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Every receipt/checkpoint must bind the actual frozen DESIRED_STATE parsed control_revision plus Git blob SHA and the actual frozen evaluation config parsed config_revision plus Git blob SHA. If a claimed revision/blob does not equal the exact frozen file or either identity is unverifiable, set bootstrap_valid=false and treat the run as diagnostic-only; it cannot count as positive Phase-1/parity evidence.
policy.control_freshness: Obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. At H1 fetch sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config, parse their revisions, and freeze both path/revision/blob identities. Repeat SHA-only head lookup before substantive work; if either authoritative identity changed, restart bootstrap. The first own-state/public-source semantic read is the semantic-freeze barrier. After that barrier, main SHA drift alone is NOT a stop. Use only non-semantic SHA/path/blob identity reads to resolve DESIRED_STATE and automation_control/roles/evaluation.json at the later head. If both blob identities equal the frozen identities and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists, record postfreeze_authority_identity_verified=true and continue the frozen semantic work without consuming newer-head file bodies, commit messages, diffs, other-role receipts, or any newer-head semantic text. Stop/checkpoint only if either frozen authority changed, cannot be verified with allowed identity-only reads, or own-state reconstruction is required. Never adopt newer control mid-run; quarantine bundled semantic payload.

postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.allowed_after_freeze: SHA-only head observation and exact path-to-blob identity verification for the two frozen authorities; role-local current-blob/CAS/readback for authorized writes
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.forbidden_after_freeze: newer-head authority file bodies or semantics, commit messages/diffs, other-role configs/receipts/state, O/downstream semantics
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.continue_when: both frozen authority blobs are unchanged and no own-state CAS/input conflict requires reconstruction
postfreeze_authority_identity_contract.diagnostic_only_when: either authority identity is mismatched or unverifiable, or receipt provenance does not match the exact frozen files

policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Discover connector/tool/schema capability only through non-mutating schema/list/discovery and read-only lookup. Never create/update/delete/move a branch, ref, file, PR, issue, release, workflow or external resource as a noop/test/probe. A connector mutation is allowed only when required by substantive evaluation work and confined to the authorized evaluation state/output or own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.repository_write_boundary: Authorized writes are confined to research_workers_clean_g1/evaluation/ role-local state/output pointers and automation_control/receipts/evaluation/ immutable receipts. Temporary/noop branches or refs and mutations outside those destinations are forbidden.

migration.reason: The first evaluation execution under DESIRED_STATE control21 still terminated solely on unrelated post-semantic-freeze main-SHA drift, did not author/execute checker-v2, and its durable receipt claimed config_revision 7 even though the exact repository config was revision6/blob 1cbb89f303e6a61a68f83b888bd6344ca1a49af4. Other CLEAN roles demonstrated that control21 identity-based continuation is executable, so config7 targets evaluation's postfreeze identity verification and exact receipt provenance without changing CLEAN semantics or substantive Phase-1 assignment.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if config7 consumes newer-head semantics, fails to stop on a real/unverifiable authority change, or blocks an explicitly authorized evaluation role-local substantive write/safe checkpoint. Never relax CLEAN isolation, checker-v2 hard gates, receipt provenance, or repository write boundaries.
